description: This Java source file defines the CheckDueInstallmentsBusinessStep class, which implements logic to check due installments for a loan and trigger a custom snapshot event if certain conditions are met. It is part of the loan processing COB (Close of Business) steps within the Fineract project.

classes.name: CheckDueInstallmentsBusinessStep
classes.description: A Spring component that performs a COB step to check for due installments in a loan and posts a custom snapshot business event if installments are due today and not fully paid.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main logic that evaluates the loan's repayment schedule and triggers a business event if due installments are found for today.

methods.name: getEnumStyledName
methods.description: Returns a string representing the enum style name of this COB step.

methods.name: getHumanReadableName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable name for this COB step.
